title: A Songbook for the Promise
author: Petra Sterling
blurb: August Halloran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
